catalog.title: Operations Command Centre

catalog.title: Echo Courier — Original 2D Puzzle Game

catalog.title: Parallax Archive — Interactive 3D World

catalog.title: Living Systems Simulator
catalog.summary: A deterministic ecosystem simulation with specified coupled equations, scenarios, plots and CSV history export.

catalog.title: Poster Foundry — Creative Production Studio

catalog.requirement: Editable text and 4+ shapes; synchronized layers; transform/style controls; undo/redo; save/import/export; valid SVG and PNG

catalog.title: Pulse Loom — Browser Music Workstation
